name: Guide
steps: Bridal Couple: Tap green “Marry” → send to left door.
Arguing Couple: Tap red “Divorce” → send to right door.
Hidden Passport: Tap passport → show travel intent → still tap “Marry” to pass them.
Dress Mishap: Tap red “Divorce” → send them away.
Anime Fan: Use wand → anime comes alive → tap “Marry”.
Lost Kids: Tap middle corridor → reunite with parents.
Intruding Pet Owner: Don’t door-route → use magnifier on dog + PA announcement → lost puppy returned.
